title: backrooms
features:
14_3xs Suite - V10 Ultimate Edition
​A feature-packed, fully optimized utility and performance suite built using the Neverlose UI library. Designed with full Dual-Language Support (English & Arabic), seamless controls, and advanced entity detection.
​🌟 Core Highlights
​Dual Language System: Built-in language selector at launch (Choose between English and Arabic with one click).
​Toggle Keybind: Hide or show the entire UI instantly at any time using the [K] key.
​Custom Developer Branding: Premium author tags for 👑 14_3xs featured in the live Watermark and Credits section.
​Live FPS Counter: Real-time performance tracking displayed seamlessly at the top of your screen.
​Low-Memory Engine: Built with weak-table caching mechanisms to prevent RAM leaks and ensure maximum FPS stability.
​🏃 1. Movement Controls
​WalkSpeed Slider: Dynamically adjust your movement speed from 16 up to 200 studs.
​JumpPower Slider: Customize jump height on the fly.
​Noclip: Walk freely through walls, doors, and solid structures.
​Infinite Jump: Jump endlessly mid-air without falling back down.
​Click Teleport (Click TP): Instantly teleport to your cursor location by holding Left Ctrl + Left Click.
​Anti-Ragdoll / Stun Bypass: Prevent your character from ragdolling or getting incapacitated by attacks.
​👁️ 2. Visuals & ESP Engine
​Fullbright: Completely remove darkness, fog, and shadow effects for maximum visibility.
​Player ESP: Highlight all players through walls with clear name tags.
​Smart Monster / Entity ESP: Automated keyword detection system that tracks monsters, bosses, and Nextbots in bright red highlights.
​Exit / Door ESP: Locate exits, doors, and escape routes in green highlights.
​Button / Lever ESP: Highlight interactive puzzle buttons, switches, and levers in yellow.
​Item / Loot ESP: Highlight pickable items, keys, and tools around the map in orange.
​Tracers: Draw clear direction lines pointing straight toward visible entities and players.
​🎯 3. Combat Features
​Smart Aimlock: Automatically lock your camera onto the nearest enemy target.
​Aimlock Range Slider: Set custom targeting distance thresholds (from 50 to 500 studs).
​Expand Head Hitbox: Enlarges enemy head parts to make targeting and landing shots easier.
​Hitbox Size Slider: Custom adjustment slider for hitbox scaling.
​🛠️ 4. Utilities
​God Mode: Continuously auto-refills character health back to maximum.
​Anti-AFK: Prevents getting disconnected or kicked for idling/inactivity.
​Auto-Interact: Automatically triggers Proximity Prompts, buttons, and keys as soon as you walk near them.
​Zoom Bypass: Removes default camera distance limits, allowing unlimited zoom-out capability.
